Details
Some details and explanations in [Game Page](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/en_Zuma_Deluxe.md) and some instruccions in [Setup Page](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/setup_en.md)

zuma-deluxe-v0.2.0-b.description:
Beta Release for a Archipelago of Zuma Deluxe

A playable version of the randomizer for Zuma Deluxe, still changes to come.

# Last Changes and Fixes
## Changes
- When conecting to a game with the Zuma Deluxe Client it will unlock all _Stages_ in **Adventure Mode** allowing you to play any of the 12 temples from a fresh file.
- Changed the basic names for items and some locations.
- Added groups for items and locations (in Details will be a link for a list of them) .
- Added icon in the archipelago client list.
- Remade how Useful Items get calculated.
- Some Yaml option like coins are now by amount and not percentage
## Fixes
- Solved some looping issues that appeared with new pointers.
- Corrected the amount of points detected by making chains.
- Removed instakill from Rush (more in Filler Items Segments).
- Shift Color doesnt generate fake balls anymore (low tested).
- No more coins in Space.
# Filler Items 
- Filler items are stackable at a higger count of 120 for instant items, or a duration of a minute for the long ones.
- Rush now only doubles the speed of the level, with a duration of 5 seconds.
- Color Shift has a duration of 10 seconds.
- Get a Break has a duration of 10 seconds.

# Details
Some details and explanations in [Game Page](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/en_Zuma_Deluxe.md) and some instruccions in [Setup Page](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/setup_en.md).
List on Groups in [Group List](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/blob/ZumaDeluxe/worlds/zuma_deluxe/docs/en_Zuma_Deluxe_groups.md)


# Know Issues
Some know stuff planned for the future:
- Filler items still has a effect even paused, there is no solution for that yet.
- The Client will get better icons clearer details on unlocked areas and remaining checks.
- This is included for both modes, and locations.
- New Options on yaml are not yet implemented or connected, like sanitys.


 # Remainders
You need to have the Zuma Deluxe Client and the Zuma Deluxe game open at the same time to play

If you connect while you have a level open in Zuma go back to the menu.

If the game is not found it probably is the language of it

To keep track of locations use universal tracker

When entering a map, always use the new game, it might not recognize the mode otherwise

Deathlink accelerates the game into a own death.

Any question, Bug or idea, feel free to ask on the discord channel for the game.
# **_Have Fun_**

Deathlink wasn't working correctly in the client almost being ignore, now deathlink works like the old rush trap making the game faster, beating a level will make you survive the deathlink combos will stun it.

# Compatible Version

This release is a hot fix of version [0.2.0](https://github.com/Movido51/Archipelago/releases/tag/zuma-deluxe-v0.2.0-b) its compatible with the games made in that version, and only affects the client.



# Remainders
You need to have the Zuma Deluxe Client and the Zuma Deluxe game open at the same time to play

If you connect while you have a level open in Zuma go back to the menu.

If the game is not found it probably is the language of it

To keep track of locations use universal tracker

When entering a map, always use the new game, it might not recognize the mode otherwise

Any question, Bug or idea, feel free to ask on the discord channel for the game.

## **_Have a Lovely Week_**
